items.title: Jensen Huang broke Nvidia’s code of conduct, and his employees may not forget it
items.summary: Most codes of conduct serve as a reflection of corporate culture. In Nvidia's case, that could have consequences.
items.creator: Russell Brandom

items.title: The canceled Tesla Cybertruck is the fastest-selling used truck in America
items.summary: The Tesla Cybertruck was the fastest-selling used truck last month, averaging just 39.1 days on the market compared to 65.5 days for trucks overall.
items.creator: Kirsten Korosec

items.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals’ accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, even as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.
items.creator: Rebecca Bellan
